how: Halo 2 player appearance in the configuration botcore builds (native/h2.cpp: cfg + 0x18 = player 0 + 0xC0). Decoded live Oct 24 on Lockout: +0x5C species (0 Spartan, 1 Elite: the bot's biped became elite_mp; the local player's was 2, also Spartan), +0x58 primary colour (10 turned the whole suit teal, seen), +0x59 secondary colour (the accents), then by Halo 2's own layout (s_player_appearance: four change colours, character, emblem foreground, background, flags) +0x5A / +0x5B the emblem's two colours, +0x5D emblem foreground (64), +0x5E background (32). 18 colours (MCC's Halo 2 list). Halo 2 has no armor pieces and MCC adds nothing a match shows, so Original and Modern are the same; no armor effects.
